from z3 import *

# Declare symbolic variables used in the constraints.
# We model the relevant fields of the stream `st` and loop/tag variables.
# - tag: integer tag identifier (e.g., TAG_JPEG2, TAG_STREAMBLOCK, ...)
# - i, nb_streams: loop counter and stream count
# - codec_id: codec identifier (e.g., AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG)
# - codec_type: media type (e.g., AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO)
# - st_id: the stream's id field (st->id)
# - ch_id: channel id used in comparisons
tag         = Int('tag')
i           = Int('i')
nb_streams  = Int('nb_streams')
codec_id    = Int('codec_id')
codec_type  = Int('codec_type')
st_id       = Int('st_id')
ch_id       = Int('ch_id')

# Symbolic constants for the tag values referenced in the constraints.
TAG_JPEG2       = IntVal(0)   # placeholder symbolic value
TAG_STREAMBLOCK = IntVal(1)
TAG_VIDEOFRAME  = IntVal(2)
TAG_STREAMHEAD  = IntVal(3)
TAG_STREAMHEAD2 = IntVal(4)
TAG_VIDEOSTREAM = IntVal(5)

# Symbolic constants for codec ids / types.
AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG   = IntVal(10)
AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO  = IntVal(20)
AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO  = IntVal(21)

s = Solver()

# Constraint 1:
#   !(;;) || !(tag == TAG_JPEG2) || !(i=0; i<s->nb_streams; i++) ||
#   !(st->codecpar->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG && st->id == -2)
# The `!(;;)` and `!(i=0; i<s->nb_streams; i++)` are C loop/empty-statement
# artifacts that are always false in a boolean sense (they are not real
# conditions), so the disjunction reduces to the meaningful part:
#   !(tag == TAG_JPEG2) || !(codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG && st_id == -2)
# We include it because it constrains `tag`, `codec_id`, and `st_id`.
s.add(Or(tag != TAG_JPEG2,
         Not(And(codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_MJPEG, st_id == -2))))

# Constraint 2:
#   !(;;) || !(tag == TAG_STREAMBLOCK) || !(i = 0; i < s->nb_streams; i++) ||
#   !(st->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && st->id == -1)
# Reduces to: !(tag == TAG_STREAMBLOCK) ||
#             !(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && st_id == -1)
# Included because it constrains `tag`, `codec_type`, and `st_id`.
s.add(Or(tag != TAG_STREAMBLOCK,
         Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, st_id == -1))))

# Constraint 3:
#   !(;;) || !(tag == TAG_VIDEOFRAME) || !(i=0; i<s->nb_streams; i++) ||
#   !(st->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO && st->id == ch_id)
# Reduces to: !(tag == TAG_VIDEOFRAME) ||
#             !(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO && st_id == ch_id)
# Included because it constrains `tag`, `codec_type`, `st_id`, and `ch_id`.
s.add(Or(tag != TAG_VIDEOFRAME,
         Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, st_id == ch_id))))

# Constraint 4:
#   !(;;) || !(tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD || tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD2) ||
#   !(i=0; i<s->nb_streams; i++) ||
#   !(st->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && st->id == -1)
# Reduces to: !(tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD || tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD2) ||
#             !(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && st_id == -1)
# Included because it constrains `tag`, `codec_type`, and `st_id`.
s.add(Or(Not(Or(tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD, tag == TAG_STREAMHEAD2)),
         Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, st_id == -1))))

# Constraint 5:
#   !(;;) || !(tag == TAG_VIDEOSTREAM) || !(i=0; i<s->nb_streams; i++) ||
#   !(st->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO && st->id == ch_id)
# Reduces to: !(tag == TAG_VIDEOSTREAM) ||
#             !(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO && st_id == ch_id)
# Included because it constrains `tag`, `codec_type`, `st_id`, and `ch_id`.
s.add(Or(tag != TAG_VIDEOSTREAM,
         Not(And(codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, st_id == ch_id))))

# Check satisfiability and print a model if one exists.
print(s.check())
if s.check() == sat:
